controles.affirmation: JUDICIAIRE - Le 10-K precise que si Millrose refusait d'honorer ses options d'achat, une action en justice ne garantirait pas la livraison des terrains
controles.verbatim_source: If they fail to do so, that could delay or prevent us from building and delivering homes, including while we seek legal enforcement. Even if we were to succeed in any legal proceedings against Millrose, there is no guarantee that a court would compel Millrose to deliver the homesites to us.

controles.affirmation: La majorite des accords de land banking est concentree sur un nombre limite d'acteurs dont Millrose
controles.verbatim_source: majority of our land banking arrangements are concentrated in a limited number of land banks, including Millrose, which exposes our business to risks if one of our principal land banks were to face financial difficulties.

controles.affirmation: Incitations commerciales de 12,9% au T2 2026 alors que la direction juge le niveau normalise entre 4% et 6%
controles.verbatim_source: Additionally, the gap between our current incentive levels of 12.9% and normalized levels of 4% to 6% is narrowing for the first time in three years

controles.affirmation: Marge brute sur ventes de maisons : 22,1% au T4 2024, 17,0% au T4 2025, 15,2% au T1 2026, 15,6% au T2 2026 ; environ 16% vise au T3 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Gross margin on home sales of 22.1% (EX-99.1 T4 2024) / of 17.0% (T4 2025) / of 15.2% (T1 2026) / of 15.6% (T2 2026) ; "We expect gross margins to be approximately 16%" (T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Le ratio dette homebuilding sur capital total a quasiment double en un an, de 8,9% au T1 2025 a 15,8% au T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Homebuilding debt to total capital 15.8 % 15.7 % 11.0 %" (31 mai 2026 / 30 nov. 2025 / 31 mai 2025). 10-K FY2025 : "Homebuilding debt to total capital 15.7% 7.5%" (30 nov. 2025 / 30 nov. 2024). EX-99.1 T1 2025 : "Homebuilding debt to total capital of 8.9%"
controles.correction_proposee: Les deux bornes chiffrees (8,9% et 15,8%) sont exactes mais elles sont distantes de cinq trimestres, pas d'un an - le corps de l'argument le dit d'ailleurs lui-meme. Sur douze mois glissants le ratio passe de 11,0% (31 mai 2025) a 15,8% (31 mai 2026), soit +44%, ce qui n'est pas un doublement. Ecrire "quasiment double en quinze mois", ou basculer sur la comparaison d'exercice a exercice reellement doublante (7,5% au 30 nov. 2024 -> 15,7% au 30 nov. 2025).

controles.affirmation: Objectif de livraisons 2026 abaisse d'environ 85 000 a environ 82 000-83 000 maisons
controles.verbatim_source: We expect that deliveries for the full year will be approximately 85,000 homes (T4 2025) / Given current pressure on interest rates and geopolitical uncertainty we are moderating our target full-year 2026 deliveries to approximately 82,000 to 83,000 homes (T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: BPA dilue 1,24 $ au T2 2026 (1,31 $ hors mark-to-market) contre 1,81 $ ; BPA dilue FY2025 de 7,98 $ contre 14,31 $, soit -44%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Basic and diluted earnings per share $ 7.98 14.31 13.73" ; EX-99.1 T2 2026 : "Net earnings per diluted share of $1.24 ($1.31 excluding mark-to-market losses on technology investments)" et "compared to second quarter net earnings attributable to Lennar in 2025 of $477 million, or $1.81 per diluted share"

controles.affirmation: Prix de vente moyen de 371 000 $ au T2 2026 contre 430 000 $ au T4 2024 ; marge nette sur ventes de maisons 6,4% au T2 2026 contre 8,9% au T2 2025 et 14,9% au T4 2024
controles.verbatim_source: Our average sales price was $371,000, reflecting approximately 12.9% in incentives (T2 2026) ; "our average sales price, net of incentives, per home delivered was $430,000 in the fourth quarter" (T4 2024) ; "Net margin on home sales of 6.4%" (T2 2026), "8.9%" (T2 2025), "14.9%" (T4 2024)

controles.affirmation: Aucun tirage sur la ligne de credit revolving de 3,1 Mds $
controles.verbatim_source: No outstanding borrowings under the Company's $3.1 billion revolving credit facility
